description: Covers data management plans (DMPs) for research projects: what funders require, drafting a DMP from the project's actual data reality (types, volumes, storage, sharing, preservation, responsibilities, costs), machine-actionable DMPs (RDA common standard, Data Stewardship Wizard, DMPonline funder templates), and keeping the plan synchronized with practice. Use when a proposal or project needs a DMP, when the user mentions data management plans, maDMPs, DS-Wizard or DMPonline, when funder or institutional data policy applies, or when the existing DMP has drifted from what the project actually does with its data. (Day-to-day data practice is rseng-data-management; the software management plan twin is rseng-management-planning.)
